activity.notes: Verwoerd remained Prime Minister when the Union of South Africa became the Republic of South Africa on 31 May 1961 and served until his assassination in Parliament on 6 September 1966. ATLAS separates the Union and Republic constitutional polities while preserving the continuity of his premiership.

sources.title: Hendrik Verwoerd becomes Prime Minister — South African History Online
sources.citation_text: South African History Online records Hendrik Verwoerd assuming office as Prime Minister on 2 September 1958, the establishment of the Republic of South Africa on 31 May 1961, and his assassination on 6 September 1966.

sources.title: Hendrik Frensch Verwoerd — South African History Online
sources.citation_text: South African History Online identifies Verwoerd as Prime Minister from 1958 and a central architect of apartheid.
